title: MusicSem: A Semantically Rich Language–Audio Dataset of Natural Music Descriptions

bias_targets.methodology: Visualizing and analyzing the frequency distribution of music genres within the collected dataset to identify the overrepresentation of specific musical styles (e.g., rock, metal, electronic, and pop) stemming from subreddit selection.
Plotting the distribution of song occurrences across dataset posts to identify power-law distributions and measure the disparity between mainstream and niche music representation.

Qualitative assessment of the dataset's source platform demographics (Reddit), acknowledging inherent selection biases toward younger, digitally engaged, and predominantly Western, English-speaking populations.
